name: check_appointment_availability
description: check_appointment_availability: Check available time slots for a given appointment type on a specific date. Returns a list of available HH:MM time slots. If no slots are available on the requested date, returns up to 3 alternative dates that do have openings.

department_code.description: The department to check availability for

preferred_date.description: The date to check in YYYY-MM-DD format. Example: 2026-05-01
